newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Amoco Corp opens office in Rio de Janeiro.
newsitem.headline: Amoco Corp opens office in Rio de Janeiro.

text.p: Amoco do Brazil, a unit of Amoco Corporation, said it has opened a representative office in Rio de Janeiro to seek business opportunities in the country's power sector.

"Brazil has many factors influencing its future growth. Amoco hopes to find investment opportunities here that will allow us to form long lasting and deep friendships with the people here," said Lee Distefano, Amoco do Brazil's vice president of Petroleum and Gas Division, in a statement.
Amoco already operates in Brazil a poplypropylene plant in Curitiba and it has formed a joint-venture with Rhone-Poulenc to operate a purified terephthalic acid plant in Sao Paulo.
